description: This file defines the EncryptionService class responsible for managing encryption and decryption operations, protocol version handling, key management, and sync event responses within a secure data storage system. It integrates various encryption-related services and manages protocol versions, key creation, and backup functionalities.

classes.name: EncryptionService
classes.description: Manages encryption/decryption, protocol versions, key lifecycle, and sync events within the application.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encryption service, including root key setup.

methods.name: getEncryptionDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the current encryption protocol.

methods.name: hasAccount
methods.description: Checks if an account exists.

methods.name: hasRootKeyEncryptionSource
methods.description: Checks if a root key encryption source is available.

methods.name: getUserVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current protocol version used by the user.

methods.name: upgradeAvailable
methods.description: Determines if an upgrade to the latest protocol version is available.

methods.name: getSureDefaultItemsKey
methods.description: Retrieves the default items encryption key.

methods.name: reencryptItemsKeys
methods.description: Re-encrypts all items keys with the current root key.

methods.name: createNewItemsKeyWithRollback
methods.description: Creates a new items key with rollback capability.

methods.name: decryptErroredPayloads
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt payloads that previously failed.

methods.name: itemsKeyForPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the items key associated with a payload.

methods.name: defaultItemsKeyForItemVersion
methods.description: Gets the default items key for a specific protocol version.

methods.name: encryptSplit
methods.description: Encrypts a split of payloads, handling multiple key types.

methods.name: decryptSplit
methods.description: Decrypts a split of payloads, handling multiple key types.

methods.name: accountUpgradeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an account protocol upgrade is available.

methods.name: passcodeUpgradeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a passcode upgrade is available.

methods.name: platformSupportsKeyDerivation
methods.description: Determines if the environment supports key derivation based on version and environment.

methods.name: supportedVersions
methods.description: Returns supported protocol versions.

methods.name: isVersionNewerThanLibraryVersion
methods.description: Checks if a version is newer than the library's latest supported version.

methods.name: costMinimumForVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum cost parameter for a given protocol version.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes a root key from a password and key parameters.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key with specified parameters.

methods.name: decryptBackupFile
methods.description: Decrypts a backup file.

methods.name: createKeyParams
methods.description: Creates key parameters from raw data.

methods.name: createEncryptedBackupFile
methods.description: Creates an encrypted backup file from current items.

methods.name: createDecryptedBackupFile
methods.description: Creates a decrypted backup file from current payloads.

methods.name: hasPasscode
methods.description: Checks if a passcode is set.

methods.name: isPasscodeLocked
methods.description: Checks if the passcode is currently locked.

methods.name: getRootKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves root key parameters.

methods.name: getAccountKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves account key parameters.

methods.name: computeWrappingKey
methods.description: Computes a wrapping key from a passcode.

methods.name: unwrapRootKey
methods.description: Unwraps the stored root key with a given wrapping key.

methods.name: setNewRootKeyWrapper
methods.description: Sets a new root key wrapper.

methods.name: removePasscode
methods.description: Removes the passcode and related key wrappers.

methods.name: setRootKey
methods.description: Sets the root key and optional wrapping key.

methods.name: getRootKey
methods.description: Returns the in-memory root key.

methods.name: deleteWorkspaceSpecificKeyStateFromDevice
methods.description: Deletes root key and wrapper from device storage.

methods.name: validateAccountPassword
methods.description: Validates the account password.

methods.name: validatePasscode
methods.description: Validates the passcode.

methods.name: getEmbeddedPayloadAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Retrieves authenticated data embedded in a payload.

methods.name: getKeyEmbeddedKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves key parameters embedded in a payload.

methods.name: needsNewRootKeyBasedItemsKey
methods.description: Determines if a new root key-based items key is needed.

methods.name: createNewDefaultItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new default items key.

methods.name: getPasswordCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the password was created.

methods.name: onSyncEvent
methods.description: Handles sync events to trigger key and data management actions.

methods.name: handleDownloadFirstSyncCompletion
methods.description: Handles actions after the first download sync completes.

methods.name: handleFullSyncCompletion
methods.description: Handles actions after a full sync completes.

methods.name: syncUnsyncedItemsKeys
methods.description: Syncs items keys that haven't been synced yet.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about the encryption state.
